name: Vegetable Salad
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: tsp. salt, and pepper to taste

instructions:
Drain all liquid from above items and mix together.
Add: 1 green pepper - diced small, 1 cup celery, diced small, 1 onion, chopped small, 1 teaspoon salt and then pepper to taste.

Mix 1 cup sugar, 1/2 cup oil, 3/4 cup vinegar. Add together in sauce pan and bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes.

Let cool and then pour over the above mixed vegetables. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.
